title: Drafting Table Design System
idiom: technical pen drawing on vellum, one sheet in two grounds, paper and phosphor
hero_prompt: Technical pen-and-ink drawing in the manner of an engineer's drafting sheet, hand-made on paper, flat and graphic with visible ruled ink line and crosshatch texture, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field, wide panoramic composition: one long drafting sheet, the left two-thirds cream paper with black ink drawing and the right third deep green with the same drawing in bright green lines, as if one sheet were turned by day and by night; across both, the same set of plain control parts drawn as solid ink-outlined objects with hatched shaded sides, a round knob with a ring of short tick marks, a sliding fader with a flat slot, a toggle switch, a row of vertical meter bars filled with hatching, and a small round oscilloscope window; thin dimension lines with small end ticks beside them, no numerals, nothing lettered. Cream, black, engineering red accents and green.
icon_prompt: Ink emblem, a flat single-colour black silhouette on a cream ground, no shading or gradients: a bold round control knob seen from above with a thick pointer notch cut into its rim and an open arc of five thick short tick marks around it. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
